messages:
emma: Customer flagged a big unexpected billing spike for embeddings yesterday. They say the console shows 'units' as tokens but the numbers match vector counts, and some requests look doubled. They opened a support ticket referencing invoice INV-9842. Can someone triage?

support-bot: Ticket #S-10234 created and linked to customer org AcmeAI. Priority: P1 (possible billing impact).

devon: Got it — can you paste the exact console screenshot or a permalink? Also need the request IDs or sample API request timestamps so we can correlate ingestion -> meter.

emma: Screenshot: <link to screenshot>. Sample requests: 2026-03-12T15:02:11Z req=rc_7f3a, 2026-03-12T15:02:14Z req=rc_7f3d. Customer says these were batched calls for 10 vectors each.

tara: Quick note — we rolled out the embeddings dashboards change last week (unit selector + new aggregation layer). Might be related.

devon: Repro attempt: pulled usage events for those request ids from event-store: 
```
SELECT * FROM embeddings_events WHERE req_id IN ('rc_7f3a','rc_7f3d');
```
Events show both per-vector entries and a single per-request summary emitted by the meter. That would explain doubling if the dashboard sums both.

mina: I'm checking the aggregation pipeline (metrics-agg v2). Looking at the job logs 2026-03-12 15:00-15:10: I see two distinct transforms: one that normalizes raw_items -> vectors and one that also runs a legacy emitter that creates 'tokens_equivalent' derived metric. They both have metric_name=embeddings_usage but different labels. Dashboard code was supposed to dedupe by label, but the new selector may be ignoring label.

billing-bot: Alert: provisional invoice for AcmeAI shows +12k embed-units between 15:00-16:00 UTC. No other service spikes.

emma: Customer is escalated to finance — they want a temporary credit if this is on us. Please keep them updated.

devon: Minimal repro steps for engineers: 1) send a batched embeddings request with 10 vectors; 2) confirm event-store contains both per-vector events and one batch-summary event; 3) render dashboard with unit selector = tokens. If both events are summed without dedupe, total doubles. Example request (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RL_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["a","b",... up to 10]}'
```

mina: Patch idea: update dashboard backend to prefer summary events when present (label precedence), and add retroactive re-aggregation job for 2026-03-12 window. I'm spinning up a short job to re-aggregate AcmeAI's window and will post results.

tara: Also add a visible unit legend on the dashboard (vectors vs tokens) and a tiny tooltip explaining how batched vs per-item metering is handled. Product will own the UI fix, eng will own the aggregation rule.

devon: Created internal issue ENG-MET-412. Suspect root cause: metric rename + aggregation dedupe regression in metrics-agg v2. Assigning to @mina and tagging @tara for UI follow-up.

mina: Re-agg job started (job id: reagg-1799-acme). Preliminary result: totals for that hour are halved when we prefer summary events — matches what customer expected. Will run full window and share patch.

emma: Forwarding this to the customer with a short interim note: "We're investigating a dashboard aggregation bug that can double-count embeddings when batch summaries and per-item events are both present. We'll run a re-aggregation and update your provisional invoice."

support-bot: Updated ticket #S-10234: status -> investigating. Added ENG-MET-412 link.

tara: Thanks team. After we confirm reagg results, finance to determine credit. Also need a postmortem doc with timeline and rollout checklist before we re-enable the new dashboard globally.

devon: Will follow up with a brief postmortem draft and the patch branch link once CI finishes.

mina: Re-agg finished. Job output: original = 12,186 units, deduped = 6,092 units. Uploading CSV to the ticket. Patch PR up next.

emma: Customer contacted — they confirm the corrected numbers align with their expectations. They asked for the final credit calculation. Finance pinged.

devon: Closing loop: root cause = aggregation label mismatch after a metrics rename. Fix = prefer summary events, add unit tests, and add a dashboard flag to show which metric label was used. PR: github.com/redwood/metrics/pull/523.

tara: I'll schedule a short postmortem + rollout plan. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
